title: Oven Roasted Middle Eastern Pork Baba Ganoush
description: A twist on the traditional baba ganoush, this recipe features ground pork and a blend of Middle Eastern spices, roasted to perfection in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Transfer the pork mixture to a cast-iron skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as you go.
Roast the pork in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is no longer pink and lightly browned.
While the pork is cooking, toss the eggplant pieces with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, and spread them out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast the eggplant in the oven for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is tender and lightly browned.
Remove the pork and eggplant from the oven, and let them cool slightly.
In a blender or food processor, combine the roasted eggplant, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and blend until smooth.
Stir the roasted pork into the eggplant mixture, and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the baba ganoush to a serving bowl, and garnish with the chopped parsley.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
